summary_en: The study tests GRID radiation therapy given before standard radiation and surgery in adults with resectable extremity soft tissue sarcoma. A single priming dose of GRID is given before conventional radiotherapy (XRT) and tumor resection; the duration of XRT is not stated. The study is a single-arm pilot of about 20 people, and its stated focus is safety; a formal main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: El estudio prueba la radioterapia GRID, administrada antes de la radiación estándar y la cirugía, en adultos con sarcoma de tejidos blandos de extremidades que puede extirparse. Se administra una dosis inicial única de GRID antes de la radioterapia convencional (XRT) y la extirpación del tumor; la duración de la XRT no se indica. Es un estudio piloto de un solo grupo con alrededor de 20 personas, cuyo enfoque declarado es la seguridad; no se indica una medida de resultado principal formal.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who gave written informed consent.
If tissue is insufficient, must agree to a pre-treatment core-needle biopsy.
Some patients whose surgery for presumed benign disease showed malignancy, if no complete resection was done and at least 5 cm of tumor remains.
not_for: Prior radiotherapy to the tumor site.
Complete resection of the primary tumor, or tumor recurrence after resection.
Serious or non-healing wound, ulcer, or bone fracture in the treated limb within 5 years.
Clinically significant lymphedema in the treated limb.
Lupus, scleroderma, Sjogren's syndrome, Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, or other collagen vascular disease.
